§6Radiation-Powered Engine§f §aNuclear waste into power. 12 independent decay slots, consistent output, no radiation risk.§f §bThe Radiation-Powered Engine§f turns RBMK-type nuclear waste into usable energy with guaranteed decay times. The blueprint is only obtainable via the §bSurvivalist's Journal§f. §6Crafting§f (§bAssembly Factory§f):
§b• 8×§f Steel Ingot, §b32×§f Steel Plate, §b64×§f 4000K Superconducting Coil
§b• 24×§f 4000K Superconductor, §b16×§f Integrated Circuit Board
§b• 1×§f Breeding Reactor Core, §b1×§f Starmetal Ingot, §b1×§f Red Dye §6Usage§f:
§b• 12 input slots§f on the left, each with a corresponding progress bar
§b• Hover§f over each bar to see decay process, ticks remaining, HE/tick output
§b• Right slots§f, decayed items are dispensed here §6Acceptable Fuels§f:
§b• Long-Lived Nuclear Waste, Short-Lived Nuclear Waste, Radioactive Scraps§f (from shredding Sellafite) §ePS:§f Great sink for long-lived waste that's otherwise hard to dispose of. Each slot decays independently, so filling all 12 maximizes output. Monitor the bars to see exact HE/tick.
